Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS pref_name, drug_indication.mesh_id AS mesh_id, drug_indication.mesh_heading AS mesh_heading, drug_indication.mesh_id AS indication_curie, drug_indication.mesh_heading AS indication_label, drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase_for_ind From molecule_dictionary Join drug_indication On molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno Join compound_records On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno Join assays On compound_records.assay_id = assays.assay_id Join target_dictionary On assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid Where molecule_dictionary.therapeutic_flag = 1 And drug_indication.max_phase_for_ind = 1 And assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' Order By chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind
